dishes.name: Smoky Sweet Potato Harvest Hash
dishes.title: Smoky black beans with roasted sweet potatoes and peppers
dishes.method: Combine the roasted sweet potatoes, peppers, and smoky black beans in a large pan. Heat over a medium flame for 5-8 minutes until piping hot throughout, stirring gently to avoid breaking the potatoes. Serve in a bowl with all components mixed together.
dishes.why: This vegan dish anchors the table with a loud vegetable profile and smoky, slow-cooked depth from the black beans.

dishes.name: Zesty Chicken and Root Roast
dishes.title: Smoky pan-seared chicken with roasted sweet potatoes and peppers
dishes.method: In a wide pan, reheat the roasted vegetables and the chicken thighs together for 8 minutes until hot. Squeeze the lemon over the chicken before serving. Arrange the vegetables first, then the chicken, then the sweet potatoes.
dishes.why: A protein-focused version of the harvest hash using pan-seared chicken to bypass the single-tray oven limit.

dishes.name: Zesty Chicken and Root Roast
dishes.title: Smoky pan-seared chicken with roasted sweet potatoes and peppers
dishes.method: Reheat the vegetables and chicken in a pan for 8 minutes. Serve the chicken and sweet potatoes first, followed by the roasted peppers. Avoid any fennel-based seasonings.
dishes.why: A warm, satisfying lunch that respects the no-fennel house rule while providing a hearty protein anchor.

dishes.name: Zesty Chicken and Root Roast
dishes.title: Smoky pan-seared chicken with roasted sweet potatoes and peppers
dishes.method: Toss the chicken and vegetables in a pan over medium heat for 8 minutes. Serve the chicken and potatoes first, then the peppers. Ensure no sesame products are used in the preparation.
dishes.why: This dish provides a safe, sesame-free lunch with a warm, smoky profile that fits the house theme.

dishes.name: Deep Smoke Bean & Greens Braise
dishes.title: Smoky black beans with wilted spinach
dishes.method: Heat the smoky beans in a pan. Once bubbling, stir in the spinach until it wilts into the sauce (about 2 minutes). Serve hot in a deep bowl.
dishes.why: A warm, slow-cooked bean dish that provides a comforting vegan dinner with a loud green vegetable presence.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Chicken & Wilted Greens
dishes.title: Smoky chicken thighs with garlic spinach
dishes.method: Sauté the garlic and spinach in a pan for 2 minutes until wilted. Add the chicken thighs to the pan to reheat for 5 minutes. Serve the spinach first, followed by the chicken.
dishes.why: A protein-rich dinner that uses fresh greens to provide a loud vegetable element alongside the smoky chicken.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Chicken & Wilted Greens
dishes.title: Smoky chicken thighs with garlic spinach
dishes.method: Wilt the spinach with garlic in a pan, then add the chicken to reheat. Serve the chicken and any starch first, then the spinach. Ensure no fennel is present.
dishes.why: A simple, warm dinner that avoids the household's forbidden ingredients while maintaining the smoky theme.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Chicken & Wilted Greens
dishes.title: Smoky chicken thighs with garlic spinach
dishes.method: Quickly cook the spinach and garlic, then reheat the chicken in the same pan. Serve the protein first. Double-check that no sesame oil or seeds were used.
dishes.why: A safe and nutritious dinner that provides a warm element as required by the coach's method.

preparations.title: Smoky Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Peppers
preparations.method: Toss the potatoes, peppers, and onions with oil, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread on a single large baking tray. Roast at 200°C for 30-35 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the peppers are charred at the edges.

preparations.title: Deep Smoke Black Bean Braise
preparations.method: In a pot, combine beans, tomatoes, garlic, and smoke flavouring. Simmer on low heat for 20 minutes until the sauce has thickened and the flavours have melded. Season with salt and pepper.

preparations.title: Smoky Pan-Seared Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Rub the chicken with oil, paprika, salt, and pepper. Sear in a hot pan for 6-8 minutes per side until deeply browned and cooked through. Allow to rest before portioning.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven and prep the sweet potatoes and peppers. Get the veg tray in the oven immediately. While they roast, start the black bean braise in a pot and let it simmer. Sear the chicken thighs in a large pan on the stovetop. By the time the chicken is rested and the beans are thick, the roasted vegetables will be ready. Box everything into the named portions.
